title: agent-model-cap's long sentence on line 11 splits under the STE limit
why: Lane agent-served-model-check (#2442, batch 69), relayed by the coordinator 08:58 CST Nov 9: docs/decisions/agent-model-cap.md line 11 holds a 35-word sentence (STE001 limit 30). note: Fix: a docs-only PR splits it at its first semicolon or "and", meaning kept. Docs-only, so it merges on passing checks (decision docs-only-prs-skip-review). Lane session_013NEJKzvX8gzYSZhs2sfsew (agent-served-model-check) takes it as a separate docs-only PR, 09:00 CST Nov 9 (coordinator).
